title: Predicting Music Valence and Arousal via Textual and Multimodal In-Context Learning in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.31202v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While arousal can be reliably predicted from musical audio, emotional valence remains difficult to model due to its subjective and context-dependent nature. In this work, we investigate the potential of in-context learning (ICL) with large language models to advance continuous valence and arousal prediction. Rather than predicting emotion scores directly, our framework leverages contextual demonstrations from an auxiliary dataset to refine the initial predictions produced by a small, task-specific base model. We systematically evaluate a text-based ICL variant using lyrics and generated audio captions, alongside a multimodal variant that incorporates raw audio signals. Using the entire MER60 dataset strictly as a held-out test set, our experiments demonstrate substantial performance gains, particularly for valence. translated_title: 基于大型语言模型中文本与多模态上下文学习的音乐效价与唤醒度预测
translated_abstract: 虽然唤醒度可以从音乐音频中可靠地预测，但由于情绪效价具有主观性和情境依赖性，其建模仍然十分困难。在这项工作中，我们探索了利用大型语言模型的上下文学习（ICL）来推进连续效价与唤醒度预测的潜力。我们的框架并非直接预测情绪分数，而是利用来自辅助数据集的上下文示例来改进由小型任务专用基础模型生成的初始预测。我们系统地评估了两种变体：一种是基于文本的ICL变体，使用歌词和生成的音频描述；另一种是结合原始音频信号的多模态变体。我们将整个MER60数据集严格用作保留测试集，实验结果显示了显著的性能提升，尤其是对于效价预测。基于文本的ICL在使用80个示例的情况下将效价R²从0.110提升至0.427，而多模态变体……
tldr: 该研究提出利用大型语言模型的上下文学习（包括基于文本的多模态方法），通过上下文示例改进小型基础模型的初始预测，显著提升了音乐情绪效价与唤醒度的连续预测性能，其中效价R²从0.110提升至0.427。
en_tdlr: This study proposes using in-context learning with large language models, via both textual and multimodal approaches, to refine initial predictions from a small task-specific base model, substantially advancing continuous music valence and arousal prediction with valence R² improved from 0.110 to 0.427.
